decision.reasoning: No transfers: a single hit-free move can't fund Gabriel, and two transfers cost 4 points for marginal gain. Haaland (form 7.2, NFO A, fixture 2) captains; Evanilson (form 8.5) is vice. Starting 4-4-2 with Dewsbury-Hall over the 75%-doubtful Henderson, who sits first on the bench. Calafiori and De Cuyper are in-form defenders. Saving the free transfer and £2.6m for a stronger move later.
